ORDINANCE IV OF 1997
ORDINANCE IV OF 1997
PAKISTAN BAIT‑UL‑MAL
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Pakistan
Bait‑ul‑Mal Act, 1991
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 9th January, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 9‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information.‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Pakistan Bait‑ul‑Mal Act, 1991 (1 of 1992), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in section and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Pakistan Bait‑ul‑Mal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Substitution of section 7, Act I of 1992

ORDINANCE IV OF 1997
PAKISTAN BAIT‑UL‑MAL
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance to amend the Pakistan
Bait‑ul‑Mal Act, 1991
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 9th January, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 9‑1‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information.‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Pakistan Bait‑ul‑Mal Act, 1991 (1 of 1992), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in section and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Substitution of section 7, Act I
of 1992.‑‑In
the Pakistan Bait‑ul‑Mal Act, 1991 (1 of 1992), for section 7 the
following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"7. Terms and conditions of
service of Chairman and Members.‑‑(1) The Chairman (Ameen) and the
Members shall hold office during the pleasure of r the Federal Government.
(2) Unless the Chairman (Ameen) or a
non‑official Member elects to hold his respective office in honorary
capacity he shall receive such salary and allowances and be subject to such
terms and conditions of service as may be prescribed and shall perform such
duties as are assigned to him under this Act or the rules framed thereunder.
(3) Subject to the provisions of
subsections (4) and (5), the Chairman (Ameen) or a non‑official Member
may, by writing under his hand address to the Federal Government, resign his
office.
(4) The resignation tendered by the
Chairman (Ameen) or a Member shall not take effect until accepted by the
Federal Government.
(5) In the case of a Member, the
resignation shall be submitted to the Federal Government, through the Chairman
(Ameen)."
